Candidates supported bringing back street vendors, but moderator Mejía pressed them on how they would protect sellers. Gutierrez and Bermudez proposed a committee or commission that included vendors; Hernandez called for residents, merchants, vendors, cultural groups and city departments to devise a plan; Torres and Brown advocated designated vending spaces; and Fielder called for vendors to have a voice and be protected from criminalization.
